enc_lead: Retrieve information on {places} places, {territories} territories and {officials} colonial officials — mapped, dated and documented.
enc_card_places_desc: Search places by name, category, region and period.
enc_card_people_desc: Follow the careers of colonial officials.
enc_card_pueblos_desc: Peoples documented through the colonial record.
pueblos_no_article: We do not have a description of this people in our database yet. Try pueblosoriginarios.com for more information. If you want to volunteer for writing an entry on this people, please contact us.
pueblos_notice_1: HGIS de las Indias is a project centered on coloniality. Therefore, it carries the bias inherent to the colonial gaze. This is by design, since it is aimed at representing information in colonial documents, but for the same reason, we are aware that it cannot be the approach to represent the indigenous domain. If we pretended, we would colonize it.
pueblos_notice_2: As a proper domain resource, we recommend the site pueblosoriginarios.com. Our own resource is well-suited to represent information by authorities on indigenous peoples, however.
pueblos_notice_3: If you have ideas on how to bring the indigenous domain properly speaking into our framework, don't hesitate to contact us.
enc_home_prose: Learn about the concepts and sources behind our database. Get in touch, claim places or territories, and write a dedicated encyclopedic entry for them.

suggest_full: We're temporarily not accepting new submissions here — the review queue is full. Please try again later, once we've had a chance to process the pending ones.
